name: goToPage / replacePage / history
summary: Navigate, replace a location, or move through browser history.

npm.import: import { goToPage, replacePage, previousPage, nextPage, setRoutingMode, getRoutingMode } from '@beforesemicolon/router'
npm.registration: The npm root registers its custom elements automatically.

classic.registration: The script registers its custom elements automatically.

signatures.goToPage: (pathname: string, state?: Record<string, unknown>, title?: string) => Promise<void>
signatures.replacePage: (pathname: string, state?: Record<string, unknown>, title?: string) => Promise<void>

example.npm:
import { goToPage, replacePage, previousPage, nextPage, setRoutingMode, getRoutingMode } from '@beforesemicolon/router'

setRoutingMode('hash')
await goToPage('/about', { from: 'home' }, 'About')

guidance: Use page-link in history mode. For hash mode, use an anchor with href="#/path".
Use goToPage to push a history entry; replacePage changes the current entry. Set mode before creating the UI.
